findings.quote: The reaction was heated thermally to 100 °C for 30 mins under nitrogen
findings.message: The temperature, duration and nitrogen atmosphere are captured, but the explicitly thermal heating method should also be retained as an unmapped operational detail. A microwave tube does not establish microwave irradiation.
